verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि सर्व प्रत्यक्षदर्शिवान्।  यथा स न्यपतद्द्रोणः सूदितः पाण्डुसृञ्जयै॥१॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Alas! I shall relate to you everything, as I saw with my own eyes, how Drona fell being slain by the Pandus and the Srinjayas.

verses.sanskrit: सेनापतित्वं संप्राप्य भारद्वाजो महारथः।  मध्ये सर्वस्य सैन्यस्य पुत्रं ते वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥२॥
यत् कौरवाणामृषभादापगेयादनन्तरम्।  सैनापत्येन यद्राजन् मामद्य कृतवानसि॥३॥
verses.english: “O monarch, in as much as, today you have honoured me with the general-ship of this army, immediately after that foremost of the Kauravas, the son of the river (Ganga).

verses.sanskrit: सदृशं कर्मणस्तस्य फलं प्राप्नुहि भारत। करोमि कामं कं तेऽद्य प्रवृणीष्व यमिच्छसि॥४॥
verses.english: O Bharata, reap the adequate fruit of that act of yours. What desire of yours shall I fulfill now? Ask whatever boon you may like?"

verses.sanskrit: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा कर्णदुःशासनादिभिः।  संमन्त्र्योवाच दुर्धर्षमाचार्यं जयतां वरम्॥५॥
ददासि चेद्वरं मह्यं जीवग्राहं युधिष्ठिरम्।  गृहीत्वा रथिनां श्रेष्ठं मत्समीपमिहानय॥६॥
verses.english: If you would at all accord me a boon, then having captured that foremost of car-warriors, Yudhishthira alive, do you bring him to me.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कुरूणामाचार्यः श्रुत्वा पुत्रस्य ते वचः।  सेनां प्रहर्षयन् सर्वामिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥७॥
verses.english: Thereupon the preceptor of the Kurus hearing these words of your son, spoke the following words, thereby imparting great delight to the troops.

verses.sanskrit: धन्यः कुन्तीसुतो राजन् यस्य ग्रहणमिच्छसि।  न वधार्थं सुदुर्धर्षं वरमद्य प्रयाचसे॥८॥
verses.english: Fortunate is the king, the son of Kunti, whose capture only you desire. O invincible one, you do not ask for any other boon, such as his slaughter.

verses.sanskrit: किमर्थं च नरव्याघ्र न वधं तस्य कांक्षसे।  नाशंससि क्रियामेतां मत्तो दुर्योधन ध्रुवम्॥९॥
आहोस्वित् धर्मराजस्य द्वेष्टा तस्य न विद्यते। यदीच्छसि त्वं जीवन्तं कुलं रक्षसि चात्मनः॥१०॥
verses.english: It is wonderful that the virtuous king Yudhishthira should have none deadly inimical to him. As you desire him to live, either you intend to preserve your own race.
verses.bhavadeepa: एतां वधरूपां क्रियां मत्तो नाशंससि न संभावयसि ॥९॥

verses.sanskrit: अथवा भरतश्रेष्ठ निर्जित्य युधि पाण्डवान्। राज्यं संप्रति दत्त्वा च सौभ्रात्रं कर्तुमिच्छसि॥११॥
verses.english: Or, O foremost of the Bharatas, having defeated the Pandavas in battle, you desire to re-establish brotherly feelings (with them), by giving them back their kingdom.

verses.sanskrit: धन्यः कुन्तीसुतो राजा सुजातं चास्य धीमतः। अजातशत्रुता सत्या तस्य यत्स्निह्यते भवान्॥१२॥
द्रोणेन चैवमुक्तस्य तव पुत्रस्य भारत। सहसा निःसृतो भावो योऽस्य नित्यं हृदि स्थितः॥१३॥
verses.english: ( Bharata, when your son had been thus addressed by Drona, the feeling that was then present in his heart, suddenly round vent.

verses.sanskrit: नाकारो गूहितुं शक्यो बृहस्पतिसमैरपि।  तस्मात्तव सुतो राजन् प्रहृष्टो वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥१४॥
वधे कुन्तिसुतस्याजौ नाचार्य विजयो मम।  हते युधिष्ठिरे पार्था हन्युः सर्वान् हि नो ध्रुवम्॥१५॥
verses.english: On the event of the death of the son of Kunti in battle, O preceptor, victory cannot be inine. If Yudhishthira were to be slain, Partha is sure to slay all of us.

verses.sanskrit: न च शक्या रणे सर्वे निहन्तुममरैरपि।  य एव तेषां शेषः स्यात्स एवास्मान्न शेषयेत्॥१६॥
verses.english: Even the immortals cannot slay all of them in battle; so he that will survive the rest of them is sure to extirpate us all.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यप्रतिज्ञे त्वानीते पुनर्द्यूतेन निर्जिते।  पुनर्यास्यन्त्यरण्याय पाण्डवास्तमनुव्रताः॥१७॥
सोऽयं मम जयो व्यक्तं दीर्घकालं भविष्यति।  अतो न वधमिच्छामि धर्मराजस्य कर्हिचित्॥१८॥
verses.english: In this way, it is obvious, that my victory will endure for a long time. It is for this that I do never desire the death of the virtuous king Yudhishthira.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य जिह्ममभिप्रायं ज्ञात्वा द्रोणोर्थतत्त्ववित्।  तं वरं सान्तरं तस्मै ददौ सञ्चिन्त्य बुद्धिमान्॥१९॥
verses.english: Being apprised of his crooked intentions, Drona of keen intellect and conversant with the science of polity, accorded the boon to him after a little reflection, modifying it thus.

verses.sanskrit:
द्रोण उवाच।
              न चेद्युधिष्ठिरं वीरः पालयत्यर्जुनो युधि।  मन्यस्व पाण्डवश्रेष्ठमानीतं वशमात्मनः॥२०॥
verses.english: Drona said "If in battle, the heroic Arjuna does not protect king Yudhishthira, then you may already regard the foremost of the Pandavas, brought under your control.

verses.sanskrit: न हि शक्यो रणे पांथः सेन्द्रैर्देवासुरैरपि।  प्रत्युद्यातुमतस्तात नैतदामर्षयाम्यहम्॥२१॥
असंशयं स मे शिष्यो मत्पूर्वश्चास्त्रकर्मणि। तरुणः सुकृतैर्युक्त एकायनगतश्च ह॥२२॥
verses.english: No doubt, he is my disciple and I am senior to him in the use of weapons. But he is youthful, blessed with a good fortune and assiduous in (the execution of) his intents.

verses.sanskrit: अस्त्राणीन्द्राच्च रुद्राच्च भूयः स समवाप्तवान्।  अमर्षितश्च ते राजंस्ततो नामर्षयाम्यहम्॥२३॥
verses.english: Moreover, he has obtained weapons from Indra and Rudra; besides he has been, O king, incensed by you. It is for these reasons, that I venture not to perform what you ask me to do.
verses.bhavadeepa: मत्पूर्वः अहं पूर्वो गुरुर्यस्य एकायनगतः जयमरणान्यतरनिश्चयवान् ॥२२॥

verses.sanskrit: स चापक्रम्यतां युद्धाद्येनोपायेन शक्यते।  अपनीते ततः पार्थे धर्मराजो जितस्त्वया॥२४॥
verses.english: Withdraw Arjuna from the battle by what means so ever that can be done. On Partha being removed, the righteous Yudhishthira is as good as vanquished by you.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रहणे हि जयस्तस्य न वधे पुरुषर्षभ।  एतेन चाप्युपायेन ग्रहणं समुपैष्यसि॥२५॥
verses.english: O foremost of men, victory depends on his capture and not on the death; and his capture can be brought about by this artifice.

verses.sanskrit: अहं गृहीत्वा राजानं सत्यधर्मपरायणम्।  आनयिष्यामि ते राजन् वशमद्य न संशयः॥२६॥
verses.english: I, having seized that king devoted to truth and righteousness, will, O monarch, no doubt, bring him under your control today.

verses.sanskrit: यदि स्थास्यति संग्रामे मुहूर्तमपि मेऽग्रतः।  अपनीते नरव्याघ्रे कुन्तीपुत्रे धनञ्जये॥२७॥
verses.english: Provided, he remains even for a moment before me in battle of course, if that foremost of men the son of Kunti Dhananjaya be removed from the field of battle.

verses.sanskrit: फाल्गुनस्य समीपे तु न हि शक्यो युधिष्ठिरः।  ग्रहीतुं समरे राजन् सेन्द्रैरपि सुरासुरैः॥२८॥
verses.english: But, Oking, before the eyes of Phalguna, Yudhishthira cannot be captured in battle, even by the celestials and the Asuras exerting jointly with Indra at their head.

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              सान्तरं तु प्रतिज्ञाते राज्ञो द्रोणेन निग्रहे।  गृहीतं तममन्यन्त तव पुत्राः सुबालिशाः॥२९॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said When under these circumscription's, Drona had promised the capture of king Yudhishthira, jour greatly-foolish sons regarded the latter as already scized.

verses.sanskrit: पाण्डवेयेषु साक्षेपं द्रोणं जानाति ते सुतः। ततः प्रतिज्ञास्थैर्यार्थं स मन्त्रो बहुलीकृतः॥३०॥
verses.english: Your son was perfectly aware of the partiality Drona cherished for the Pandavas; so to make Drona strictly redeem his promise, Duryodhana gave publicity to that counsel.

verses.sanskrit: ततो दुर्योधनेनापि ग्रहणं पाण्डवस्य तत्। सैन्यस्थानेषु सर्वेषु सुघोषितमरिन्दम॥३१॥
verses.bhavadeepa: बहुलीकृतः प्रतिज्ञां न त्यजेदिति बहुषु प्रकाशितः ॥३०॥
